recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future work should only revisit this if a new work-group decision changes whether AuditEvent agents should carry a location reference.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 AuditEvent issue asking to add location (0..1) to SecurityEvent.Participant as a Location reference to support Record Lifecycle Events without a corresponding Provenance resource.
initial_application: Commit 8e3bf13ba666e95767275e11df012bf9e4d7ceba explicitly applied FHIR-5337 by adding AuditEvent.participant.location with cardinality 0..1 and type Reference(Location) to the AuditEvent spreadsheet source. The later source refactor moved AuditEvent into structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml while preserving the location element.
additional_context: The current build has AuditEvent active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini maps the old AuditEvent.participant name to the current AuditEvent.agent name. Related ballot comments FHIR-5335 and FHIR-5336 are part of the same Record Lifecycle Events context but do not change the location decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant reversal or narrowing.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml already defines AuditEvent.agent.location as 0..1 Reference(Location).

related_jiras.note: Referenced by the seed as ballot comment #216 and provides broader Record Lifecycle Events AuditEvent context.
